requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 使用 TM1637 + A0 + 按钮（D2）：默认显示电位器值，按下显示 8888
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Set io_0 to a non-integer value (e.g., 123.7) with io_1=false, then observe io_2; then set io_1=true (pressed) while keeping io_0 unchanged and observe io_2.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: When io_1=false, io_2 equals floor(io_0). When io_1=true, io_2 equals 8888.

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 使用 TM1637 + A0 + 按钮（D2）：默认显示电位器值，按下显示 8888
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: With io_1=false, sweep io_0 across several values (e.g., 0.0, 10.0, 999.0) and observe io_2 each step; then hold io_1=true and sweep io_0 across the same values and observe io_2 each step.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: With io_1=false, io_2 tracks floor(io_0) for each value. With io_1=true, io_2 is always 8888 regardless of io_0.
